prs.title: Gracefully terminate active sessions during StreamableHTTP shutdown
prs.author: Bortlesboat
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Active SSE stream writers are not closed before session tasks are cancelled during shutdown, causing Uvicorn to log ASGI-incomplete-response errors. Both PRs add the same fix: iterate `_sse_stream_writers` in `terminate()` to close each writer, clear the dict, and call `terminate()` on all active sessions in the manager's lifespan `finally` block before cancelling tasks. (2 PRs)
prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Active SSE stream writers are not closed before session tasks are cancelled during shutdown, causing Uvicorn to log ASGI-incomplete-response errors. Both PRs add the same fix: iterate `_sse_stream_writers` in `terminate()` to close each writer, clear the dict, and call `terminate()` on all active sessions in the manager's lifespan `finally` block before cancelling tasks. prs.cluster_pick_reason: PR #2259 includes an idempotency guard (`if self._terminated: return`) at the top of `terminate()` that PR #2253 omits. This prevents double-termination if `terminate()` is called concurrently or twice (e.g., once from lifespan shutdown and once from an expiry path). The rest of the two diffs are functionally identical; #2259's extra guard makes it strictly safer.
